title: Entry Requirements, Referrals and Authorizations by In-Person Appointments Visit Type
content:
Each In-Person Appointments visit type has entry requirements that describe the patient and the paperwork it is meant for, together with three coverage settings: whether an approved referral is required when the patient's financial account is on the Commercial HMO/EPO Account tier, whether an approved prior authorization is required for insured patients, and how many business days before the scheduled date that authorization must be approved.

## Entry requirements

| Visit type | Entry requirements |
|---|---|
| Nurse Visit | An order on file from a group clinician, and the patient established with the group |
| Established Patient Office Visit | A completed visit in the same department within the last 36 months |
| New Patient Office Visit | No completed visit in the same department within the last 36 months |
| Annual Preventive Exam | Minimum age 0 years, and the last completed preventive exam at least 12 months ago |
| Specialist Consultation | The department is a specialty department, and an approved referral when the patient is on the Commercial HMO/EPO Account tier |
| In-Office Procedure Visit | A procedure order on file, an approved prior authorization when the patient is insured, and consent reviewed at booking |
| Advanced Imaging Appointment | An imaging order on file, an approved prior authorization when the patient is insured, and safety screening completed |

## Coverage settings

| Visit type | Referral required on Commercial HMO/EPO Account | Prior authorization required for insured patients | Authorization approved at least this many business days before the scheduled date |
|---|---|---|---|
| Nurse Visit | No | No | 0 |
| Established Patient Office Visit | No | No | 0 |
| New Patient Office Visit | No | No | 0 |
| Annual Preventive Exam | No | No | 0 |
| Specialist Consultation | Yes | No | 0 |
| In-Office Procedure Visit | Yes | Yes | 3 |
| Advanced Imaging Appointment | Yes | Yes | 3 |

The business-day figure counts business days before the scheduled date by which the required authorization must be approved, or the clinic reschedules the visit.

## Reading the settings

- Three visit types need a referral when the patient is on the Commercial HMO/EPO Account tier: the Specialist Consultation, the In-Office Procedure Visit and the Advanced Imaging Appointment.
- Two visit types need a prior authorization for insured patients, the In-Office Procedure Visit and the Advanced Imaging Appointment, and for both the authorization lead is 3 business days.
- The Established Patient Office Visit and the New Patient Office Visit are distinguished by the same 36-month test in the same department: a completed visit inside it points to the former, none inside it to the latter.
